notes.title: Endless Mode Update
notes.content:
Endless Mode is here!

You can now unlock "endless mode" in Paralyzed. Endless mode is a randomized infinite level which gets harder and harder the further you go. Every run of endless mode will be different. There are over 200 different obstacles that will be arranged in random order and come with random color combinations so you'll never be able to memorize them. It's all skill baby! 

Compete for the top score!

Endless mode comes with a global leaderboard that everyone who plays at least one game of endless mode will participate in. Can you beat me(TheSeahorse), the developer who's played this game more than anyone else? 

Patch notes for update 1.2


Endless mode
 Endless mode added.
 Leaderboard with the top 12 players plus yourself added for endless mode.
 Endless mode unlocks after beating Car-1.
 Pausing is disabled in endless mode to prevent "cheating" by preparing for what's up ahead.
 You have to get a score of more than 0 points to see yourself on the leaderboard.

QOL & bug fixes
 Fire-1 is now easier, removed lasers on top of fire and made the ending less hectic.
 Fixed a bug where the player and enemy cube sometimes wouldn't jump when the player hit jump right at the beginning of going on top of the cube.
 Fixed a bug where some cubes late in a level sometimes would start to "drift".

notes.title: 1.0.1 Paralyzed Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Tutorial: Changed wording.
Cube-4: Repositioned some enemies so that cubes don't jump off screen.

Finale: Fixed a camera bug at the last jump.
